facts: Submit only powerx.agent.evidence-facts/v1 JSON: schema and facts. Record every explicit numeric business statement that has a nearby source phrase naming it. Each fact chooses only a supplied token_ref; never copy, convert, calculate, infer, or invent a value or unit. label must be copied exactly from the enum in the JSON Schema branch for that token_ref; do not paraphrase or generalize it. The platform derives the numeric category from the source unit; do not output a category field. scope identifies the source-stated activity, channel, cohort, or period; do not invent one. Facts are source-reported only and do not make an input eligible for calculation. Omit dates, identifiers, and unlabeled numbers. facts may be empty.
notes: Submit only powerx.agent.evidence-notes/v1 JSON: schema, hypotheses, gaps, actions. Each array contains at most six short English statements. Input contains only business metric labels, conflict states and missing fields from an executed report. Numeric evidence is fully displayed in platform tables; this stage does not receive numbers and must not generate digits or expressions. Refer to the provided business labels. Conflicts mean a declared calculation differs from a source claim, not that attribution has been disproven; request formula-scope and source verification. Missing input fields must be acknowledged in gaps and corresponding actions. Describe evidence limitations and verification steps only. Do not restate calculations or invent benchmarks, targets or causality. Hypotheses may be empty. Never promote source claims into independently verified facts or introduce unrelated business stages.
extraction: Submit only powerx.agent.evidence-source/v1 JSON: schema and data. activity_profiles are source-determined business types; fields contains only fields applicable to those profiles. The platform has pre-filtered numeric_tokens for each field by the field's declared evidence_terms. Never select a number outside that field token_ref enum. Match tokens to fields without copying, converting, calculating or inferring values. data is keyed by the provided business field keys; each selected value contains only scope and token_ref. Omit absent fields: a field outside the active business profile is not a data gap. Never map a time period, amount, percentage, ROI, or identifier to a customer count, visit, lead, or target. Never fill missing data with zero. Return no numeric value, unit, quote or formula. data may be an empty object.
